interval between CS and vaginal repair
Vaginal repair of cesarean section diverticulum (CSD)
Interval between C-section and vaginal repair
Patients with interval between CS and repair ≤2.5 years
Vaginal excision and suture of CSD
Thickness of the remaining muscular layer (TRM)
cohort: 121 patients with CSD diagnosed by transvaginal ultrasound (TVU) and experiencing postmenstrual spotting
finding: Vaginal repair of CSD effectively improved postmenstrual spotting and anatomically corrected CSD, with better outcomes observed in women who had surgery within 2.5 years of their C-section and achieved a TRM ≥8.5 mm at 6 months post-surgery.
mod_finding: An interval between C-section and surgery of ≤2.5 years was optimal for vaginal repair of CSD.
